decisions.reason: As a multi-model line closely tied to the firm's design-led core offer and still visibly promoted after its 2023 launch, management is likely to stay committed and interpret any weaker demand as temporary.
This shower channel sits squarely in the established drainage business and has remained on its own webpage across years, so the sunk development and public commitment make withdrawal unlikely.

Although the pump-drain concept is riskier given the earlier disappearance of a related pump-assisted line, its very recent 2024 launch and visible market introduction make management likely to give it more time rather than admit failure quickly.
